invitation.subject: {inviter} invited you to {organization}
invitation.introInternal: {inviter} invited you to work with the team at {organization} on TManage. Your role: {role}.
invitation.introClient: {inviter} invited you to the {organization} client portal. There you follow the progress, files and approvals shared with {client}. Your role: {role}. You will not see the team's internal workspace.
invitation.expiry: The invitation is open until {date}. Not expecting it? You can ignore this e-mail.
passwordReset.subject: Reset your TManage password
passwordReset.intro: Someone asked to reset the password of your TManage account.
passwordReset.note: The link works once and expires in {minutes} minutes. Changing your password signs you out everywhere.
passwordReset.footer: Did not ask for it? Ignore this e-mail and your password stays as it is.
emailConfirm.subject: Confirm your e-mail for TManage
emailConfirm.intro: Please confirm that this address is yours.
emailConfirm.note: The link works once and expires in {minutes} minutes. It does not sign you in or change your password.
emailConfirm.footer: Did not create a TManage account? Ignore this e-mail and nothing happens.
welcome.subject: Welcome to TManage
welcome.intro: Your workspace is ready, and you are its owner. A good first step: add one project and invite one teammate. It takes about two minutes.
welcome.note: If you get stuck or something feels missing, reply to this e-mail. A person on our team reads every reply.
welcome.footer: Sent automatically when your workspace was created. Did not create it? Write to support@tmanageapp.com and we will remove it.
emailChange.subject: Your TManage sign-in e-mail changed
emailChange.introOld: The sign-in e-mail of your TManage account was changed from {previousEmail} to {newEmail}. This address no longer signs in.
emailChange.introNew: This address is now the sign-in e-mail of your TManage account. Verify it before you sign in again.
emailChange.footer: Did not expect this? Tell your workspace owner or write to support@tmanageapp.com today.
securityAck.subject: We received your security report {reference}
securityAck.text:
Hello,
Thank you for reporting this. Your reference is {reference}.
Our security team reads every report and will write to you if more detail is needed. Please do not share the details publicly while we look into it.
To add information, reply to this e-mail and keep the reference in the subject.
mfaCode.subject: Your TManage verification code
mfaCode.introSignIn: Enter it to finish signing in to TManage.
mfaCode.introEnrol: Enter it to turn on e-mail codes for two-step verification.
mfaCode.note: It works once and expires in {minutes} minutes. We never ask for it by phone or chat.
mfaCode.footer: Did not ask for it? Someone may know your password: change it in TManage.
invitation.subjectClient: {inviter} invited you to the {organization} client portal
invitation.preheader: Join as {role}. The invitation is open until {date}.
invitation.preheaderClient: Follow progress, files and approvals for {client}.
passwordReset.preheader: The link works once and expires in {minutes} minutes.
emailConfirm.preheader: One click, and your account is ready.
